comment: companion.yml is read by two implementations in two languages — the runtime reader in speckit-extension/scripts/companion_config.py and the editor's pre-check in src/features/specs/livingSpecsModel.ts. They cannot share code, so they share these cases: every one is parsed by both test suites, and a verdict that differs fails the build. `supported: false` means the runtime falls back to the shipped defaults and the editor must agree that it will.

cases.name: an ordinary configuration
cases.yaml:
hooks:
  before:
    - command: npm run lint

cases.name: a shell command containing a redirect
an unquoted glob in a value
a flow sequence of plain scalars
a comment containing an ampersand
cases.yaml:
# tuned for CI & local
hooks:
  before: []

cases.name: an anchor definition
cases.yaml:
shared: &base
  command: npm test
hooks:
  before:
    - command: npm run lint

cases.name: an alias reference
cases.yaml:
shared: &base
  command: npm test
hooks:
  after:
    - *base

cases.name: an alias inside a flow collection
cases.yaml:
shared: &base
  command: npm test
recipe:
  nodes: [*base]

cases.name: a block scalar
cases.yaml:
hooks:
  before:
    - command: |
        npm run lint
        npm test

cases.name: a folded scalar
cases.yaml:
note: >
  a long line folded
  across two source lines
